label: copy phase: fed-back w when next output is b (or z), mid/late recall
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase; it never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter. 92% of activation mass is on steps whose input is the fed-back token w, and the rest is on fed-back b. The strongest activations are on input w when the token being output is b, meaning the original sequence contained the bigram "w b" and the model is now emitting the b. All top-12 examples are this pattern, at recall_idx 3-6, with activations of 0.66-1.0 of max. w->b alone with recall_idx>=3 has precision 0.90 but captures only 59% of mass. Weaker activation: input w with output z (about 15% of mass, but only 25% precision), input w with output w, and input b with output b (the second b of a repeated b). Rarely fires at recall_idx<=2. It does not fire on any other input token, or on the first occurrence of a token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=w (+8.11), phase=2 & in_tok=b (+4.75), next_out=b (+4.27), phase=2 & out_tok=b (+4.25), out_tok=b (+3.91), in_tok=w (+3.69). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.63), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.63), to_go=6 (-2.07), next_out=i (-2.02).
